test_data: Tests seed their own data through crates/barnacle-bot/tests/common, on in-memory SQLite pools or temporary database files migrated with migrations/, and drive the Discord side through the FakeBoard fake; the real-catalog tests skip unless BARNACLE_TEST_CATALOG_DIR names a built catalog

surfaces.name: event sign-ups and their post and clean-up timing
surfaces.kind: Discord slash commands /event create, edit, repost, end and list, the three-step event panel, and the sign-up timer that posts, closes and deletes sign-up posts
surfaces.driver: cargo test -p barnacle-bot with the project's own tests (event_*, post_timing_*, schedule, attendance*, wiring) over the pure panel builders, the store on a migrated SQLite pool and the sign-up beat with FakeBoard

surfaces.name: rehearsal clock
surfaces.kind: Discord slash commands /rehearse start, next and reset in a rehearsal server
surfaces.driver: cargo test -p barnacle-bot --test attendance and the attendance store tests, which step the rehearsal clock with FakeBoard

surfaces.name: bot updates and release notes
surfaces.kind: Discord slash command /updates and the release notes built into the bot
surfaces.driver: cargo test -p barnacle-bot --test release_notes --test updates --test updates_store

surfaces.name: bot startup checks
surfaces.kind: the barnacle-bot binary's checks of config, catalog, curation and database schema before it connects
surfaces.driver: cargo test -p barnacle-bot --test startup --test config --test migration_order

surfaces.name: container image
surfaces.kind: the Docker image and its entrypoint, which applies migrations and starts the bot
surfaces.driver: docker build with a built catalog archive, then .github/scripts/smoke.sh <image>, as .github/workflows/image.yml does

surfaces.name: silhouette game
surfaces.kind: Discord slash commands for the ship silhouette guessing game and its solves
surfaces.driver: cargo test -p barnacle-guess and cargo test -p barnacle-bot --test guess_commands --test solves --test lookup --test series

surfaces.name: IQ competition
surfaces.kind: Discord slash commands and panels for the IQ competition, its judging and its board
surfaces.driver: cargo test -p barnacle-bot with the iq_* tests

surfaces.name: Join to Create voice rooms
surfaces.kind: Discord voice channels the bot opens and moves members into

surfaces.name: game data pipeline
surfaces.kind: the barnacle-data command line: sync, diff and use of the ship catalog
surfaces.driver: cargo test -p barnacle-data -p barnacle-catalog over the project's fixtures

surfaces.name: live Discord bot
surfaces.kind: the running bot in a Discord test server, as a member sees its posts, panels and pings
surfaces.driver: cargo run --release -p barnacle-bot with the dev bot token, driven by a person in the Discord client in a rehearsal test server

no local start.value: the bot has no local start step lighthouse can run: starting it connects to Discord with a bot token and registers slash commands in the servers barnacle.toml lists
no local start.recheck: read the Running the bot section of README.md and crates/barnacle-bot/src/main.rs

dev bot token.value: the .env token is a dev bot that may be run locally against a test server for probes
dev bot token.recheck: read agent.residue.access in receipts.config.json and ask the owner

rehearsal server.value: no rehearsal test server ID is recorded in the repository

catalog.value: the container image and real-catalog tests need a built catalog, which the repository does not hold

off_limits: starting the bot with a real Discord token, which registers slash commands and posts in real servers
running /rehearse reset or /event end in any server not confirmed to be a throwaway test server
running barnacle-data sync, which downloads game data from Wargaming's servers
pushing or publishing the container image
